author: claude
summary: Task 003 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: folds the standalone IconUpload section out of OverviewTab and onto VoiceDetailHeader's avatar directly (upload/replace button under it, drag-and-drop onto the image itself).

files.change: Extracted all upload/drag-drop/dimension-probe/copy-prompt mechanics into a new exported useIconUpload({voiceId, metadata, onSuccess, onError}) hook. The IconUpload component itself is now a thin consumer of that hook, kept in place (unmounted from the app, still independently unit-tested) rather than deleted.

Avatar div is now the drag/drop target; added a persistent upload/replace button plus the icon-generation-prompt copy button underneath the avatar (new .voice-detail-header__avatar-block). Added voiceId prop usage; local iconOverride/iconUploadError state resets on voiceId change, mirroring the old OverviewTab pattern.
Removed the standalone ICON section (IconUpload mount, iconPath/iconError local state, IconUpload import).
Added .voice-detail-header__avatar-block / __icon-actions / __icon-btn layout rules, reusing existing .metadata-icon-upload__* classes rather than duplicating them.
New file. Covers the DC-013 icon-prompt regression test (moved from OverviewTab.test.tsx), upload-via-button, drop-onto-avatar, and upload-error-surfacing.

flow_impact: Fifth task landed in the voices-variants-round2 plan. Unblocks task 007 (disclosure panel), which also touches OverviewTab.tsx and VoiceDetailHeader.tsx and was sequenced to land after both 003 and 006.
